channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Voto 'dupla face' sobre fim da 6x1 torna Flávio cabo eleitoral de Lula
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro criticized Lula's proposal to end the 6x1 scale, labeling it 'opportunistic' and accusing the president of exploiting the issue for electoral support. His stance positions him as a vocal opponent of Lula's agenda.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro diz que não irá a debate da Band com Lula
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro, PL presidential candidate, said he will not attend the Band TV presidential debate but did not rule out joining the final debate before the October 25 runoff.

item.title: Corregedor do TSE pede que Kassio mande caso 'Exército do Lula' ao plenário
item.description: The TSE's rapporteur, Ricardo Villas Bôas Cueva, urged the court's president, Kassio Nunes Marques, to have the 'Exército do Lula' channel case analyzed by the full panel. The decision aims for a collective and transparent evaluation of the investigation into the content published on the channel.

item.title: Van com marca do MEC busca estudantes em comitê de campanha após gravação com Lula
item.description: A van displaying MEC (Ministry of Education) stickers sought out students who recorded a video with President Lula for his re-election campaign committee. The action followed the video's publication on the PT's social media, raising concerns about the use of official state identity in political activities.

item.title: Repórter da Jovem Pan é hostilizado em ato pró-Lula em São Paulo
item.description: A Jovem Pan reporter was harassed by pro-Lula supporters during a São Paulo rally, facing thrown objects and insults live on air. Event organizers condemned the incident, and PT leaders expressed solidarity with the journalist. The case highlights ongoing concerns about press freedom during political gatherings.

item.title: TSE referenda remoção de posts que ligam Flávio a Vorcaro e a milícias
item.description: The Brazilian Electoral Supreme Court upheld the removal of posts linking Flávio Bolsonaro to Daniel Vorcaro and organized crime, ruling that the content exceeded political criticism boundaries. The decision was made at the request of Flávio's campaign and ordered the removal of defamatory content.

item.title: Apoiadores de Lula fazem ato em Brasília
item.description: Supporters of Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) held a rally at the Esplanada dos Ministérios in Brasília, wearing red and holding signs supporting democracy, SUS, and ending the 6×1 work shift. The event occurred without Lula's direct presence.

item.title: Lula ignora empreendedor por 4 anos e agora oferece Pix de R$ 5 mil
item.description: Twelve days before the runoff, Lula launched Prospera MEI, offering forgiveness of R$12.6 billion in debts owed by microentrepreneurs to the federal government, Pix transfers of up to R$5,000 without repayment, debt renegotiation through Desenrola, and an increase in the MEI cap. The initiative aims to influence voters in a decisive moment of the 2026 electoral race.

item.title: Senado deve acelerar a votação do fim da escala 6×1 nesta quarta-feira
item.description: Senate President Davi Alcolumbre stated that the Lula government's base secured the necessary signatures to accelerate the vote on the PEC ending the 6×1 workweek. The PEC 221/2019, which reduces the weekly work hours from 44 to 40, is advancing in Congress and could be approved on Wednesday. All 36 amendments submitted so far have been rejected by the rapporteur, Omar Aziz.

item.title: ‘Nosso plano é muito simples, diz Daniella Marques, coordenadora econômica de Flávio Bolsonaro
item.description: Daniella Marques, economic coordinator for Flávio Bolsonaro, criticized Lula's economic model, claiming over 30 new taxes were created, worsening public debt, inflation and bankruptcies. She advocates for a plan focused on productivity, cost reduction and fiscal discipline.

item.title: TSE julga processos envolvendo publicações de propaganda eleitoral de Flávio Bolsonaro e Lula
item.description: The TSE judged processes related to publications of electoral propaganda involving Flávio Bolsonaro and Lula. Advertisements considered negative to both candidates were analyzed, including representations against First Lady Janja da Silva and actions by the PL against PT deputies. The Brazil Esperança Federation also filed three representations against the PL, Flávio Bolsonaro, and the 'Dama de Ferro' profile for negative propaganda against Lula.

item.title: PGR diz que não há provas contra cúpula da PF, contesta Mendonça e pede que plenário do STF encerre disputa
item.description: The Brazilian Attorney General's Office stated there is no concrete evidence to justify the removal of the Federal Police directors appointed by André Mendonça, recommending the case be archived by the STF plenary. The opinion highlights the absence of evidence for irregular surveillance or unauthorized access to the judge's data, limiting the reports to the PF's operational analysis. Gonet also contests the direct liability of Andrei Rodrigues for producing the documents.

item.title: Corregedor do TSE cobra análise urgente de decisão sobre canal “Exército do Lula”
item.description: The Chief Magistrate of Electoral Justice, Minister Ricardo Villas Bôas Cueva, urgently requested that the TSE plenary review the decision regarding the WhatsApp channel 'Exército do Lula' following disagreements with the tribunal's president, Kassio Nunes Marques. The pressure emerges amid internal tribunal disputes over the processing of electoral actions.

item.title: Tarcísio tinha expectativa de ser candidato a presidente, diz Flávio Bolsonaro
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro claimed that Tarcísio de Freitas expected to run for president in 2026, revealing internal tensions within the PL party. The statement emerged during the electoral campaign, highlighting political ambitions and alliances. This comment may influence the dynamics among conservative forces.

item.title: “Band” mantém debate com Lula e deixará púlpito vazio sem Flávio
item.description: Band kept the second-round presidential debate scheduled for October 18, stating it will leave an empty podium if any candidate does not attend, unlike the TSE's decision to ban Globo from doing the same for Lula. Flávio Bolsonaro said he has not decided yet and that his technical team will evaluate his participation. Lula confirmed his attendance at the debate.

item.title: Quem são os candidatos no segundo turno para o governo do Tocantins nas eleições 2026
item.description: Senator Professor Dorinha Seabra (Brazilian Union) and federal deputy Vicentinho Júnior (PSDB) face each other in the 2026 runoff for governor of Tocantins. Neither reached an absolute majority in the first round, with 45.52% and 43.94% of valid votes, respectively. The runoff election is scheduled for October 25.

item.title: Campanhas de Lula e Flávio tentam acordo sobre WhatsApp
item.description: The lawyers of Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro meet to propose rules to the TSE on WhatsApp usage in campaigns, aiming to reduce irregularities on social media.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro diz que não irá participar de debate da Band; Lula confirma presença
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro says he will not participate in the Band debate on Sunday and his team is still evaluating his presence at the Globo debate. Lula confirms his participation in the Band debate and hopes his opponent also attends.

item.title: Bolsonaristas ofendem memória de Marielle Franco em ato no Rio
item.description: Supporters of Flávio Bolsonaro insulted the memory of Marielle Franco at a rally near PUC-Rio, mocking her assassination. Her daughter, Luyara Franco, condemned the actions as political violence, while her sister, Anielle Franco, expressed support for pro-Lula students.

item.title: Manifestantes fazem ato pró-Lula na Esplanada dos Ministérios
item.description: Supporters held a pro-Lula rally at the Esplanada dos Ministérios in Brasília, demanding defense of democracy, the SUS, and an end to the 6×1 schedule, without the candidate’s direct presence. The event featured health professionals, students, and social movements, along with politicians linked to the PT.

item.title: Quaest: como está a disputa presidencial no DF, AC, AM e RN
item.description: Quaest polls reveal diverging trends in the presidential race between Flávio Bolsonaro and Lula in Acre, Amazonas, Federal District, and Rio Grande do Norte. Flávio leads in AC and DF, Lula in RN, with a technical tie in AM.

item.title: Câmara aprova urgência de PL sobre divisão de custos de baterias
item.description: The Chamber of Deputies approved the urgency of PL 3.716/2026, which changes the cost division for batteries in the power sector, moving to an accelerated legislative process. The bill, which divides opinions among sector stakeholders, may impact the December energy storage auctions, with the merits vote expected after the elections.

item.title: Líder do MDB no Senado sai em defesa de diretórios estaduais que apoiam Lula no segundo turno
item.description: MDB Senate leader Eduardo Braga endorsed Lula's reelection, representing 10 state directories from Northern and Northeastern regions. He emphasized social progress and warned about threats to democracy without Lula's support. Former president José Sarney and Senator Veneziano Vital do Rêgo also expressed backing for the PT candidate.

item.title: Lula escreve carta a evangélicos com defesa da família, fim das bets e da escala 6x1; leia
item.description: Lula wrote a letter to evangelical families highlighting support for the family and initiatives such as ending bets and the 6x1 scale.

item.title: Centrão espera votar aumento do teto do MEI só após o 2º turno
item.description: Center and PT leaders believe the PLP 108, which increases the MEI revenue cap, will only be voted on after the second round of elections. The government proposes the Prospera MEI package with R$12.6 billion in debt forgiveness, but the PL considers it an electoral measure. The discussion on expanding the cap to all Simples Nacional brackets is expected to be postponed.

item.title: Pesquisa Quaest: Omar Aziz tem 51% e Maria do Carmo registra 37% na disputa ao governo do Amazonas
item.description: Omar Aziz (PSD) leads with 51% of voter intentions against 37% for Maria do Carmo (PL) in the Amazonas gubernatorial runoff, according to Quaest poll. Lula leads in the state with 47% versus 43% for Flávio Bolsonaro, within the margin of error.

item.title: Com promessas de Flávio e Lula, terça-feira indica aumento de risco fiscal e evidencia limites políticos para um ajuste
item.description: Electoral promises from candidates such as Flávio Dino and Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva raise fiscal risks, highlighting political constraints for fiscal adjustment in the coming years.

item.title: Meta nega favorecimento à campanha de Flávio em resposta ao TSE
item.description: Meta denied favoring Flávio Bolsonaro's campaign on Facebook and Instagram, claiming the alleged reduction in reach of Lula supporters' posts is false and based on subjective data. The company acknowledged a global technical incident on October 7th but emphasized it affected all users, not just political content. Lula's campaign had accused Meta of manipulating reach and temporarily excluding ads.

item.title: Corregedor eleitoral insiste que discussão sobre 'Exército do Lula' ocorra no plenário do TSE
item.description: The Chief Electoral Officer Ricardo Villas Bôas Cueva urged that the debate over Lula's WhatsApp group 'Exército do Lula' be addressed by the plenary of the TSE in a face-to-face or virtual session. The campaign of Flávio Bolsonaro challenges the legality of the group, which has over 4 million subscribers and is managed by André Janones.

item.title: Governo promete distribuir Pix de R$ 5 mil. Populismo fiscal chegou ao seu limite?
item.description: President Lula announced measures for small business owners, including a R$ 5,000 Pix payment and debt forgiveness, ahead of the election. Columnist Fernando Schüler criticizes the lack of budget planning, but believes fiscal populism will not sway mature voters.

item.title: Pesquisa Quaest: Allyson tem 45% e Cadu de Lula soma 42% no Rio Grande do Norte
item.description: In Rio Grande do Norte, Allyson Bezerra (União) leads with 45% and Cadu de Lula (PT) has 42% in the Quaest poll for the state's second round, within the margin of error. Nationally, Lula leads Flávio Bolsonaro with 59% of voting intentions. Federal government approval reaches 63%, while the state administration is disapproved by 55% of respondents.

item.title: Quaest no Acre: Mailza tem 49% das intenções de voto no 2º turno contra 32% de Alan Rick
item.description: Mailza Assis leads with 49% of vote intentions in the Acre runoff, followed by Alan Rick with 32%. Quaest poll shows the governor with 64% approval in office. Parallelly, Flávio Bolsonaro leads in Acre against Lula with 60% of vote intentions.

item.title: Campanha diz que Lula vai a debate da “Band” mesmo sem Flávio
item.description: Lula confirmed his attendance at the Band debate on Sunday (October 18), despite Flávio Bolsonaro's absence. The PT campaign reaffirmed Lula's participation in all second-round debates. Flávio stated he will not attend the Band debate and his team is evaluating participation in the TV Globo debate.

item.title: Após decisão de Nunes Marques, corregedor do TSE cobra julgamento urgente sobre canal 'Exército do Lula'
item.description: TSE court clerk Ricardo Villas Bôas Cueva urgently requested the plenary to review the decision regarding the 'Exército do Lula' channel after Nunes Marques suspended a ruling without referring it to the full court. The divergence between the TSE presidency and clerkship deepens ahead of the presidential runoff.

item.title: Na TV, Flávio promete rede para crianças com espectro autista, e Lula o associa a milícias
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) used TV election ads to promise a national network of reference centers for children with autism spectrum disorder, and to maintain and expand social programs like Bolsa Família. President Lula associated Flávio's promises with militias, questioning the authenticity of his actions.

item.title: Flávio diz que levou canjica com leite condensado a Bolsonaro
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) claimed he brought corn pudding with condensed milk to his father, former President Jair Bolsonaro, during a visit in Brasília. The meeting took place after 17 state directories of MDB announced support for his candidacy for the second round. Flávio emphasized that his father is satisfied with the first round results and received guidance for the continuation of the campaign.

item.title: Flávio diz que pretende rever pontos da reforma tributária
item.description: Senator and presidential candidate Flávio Bolsonaro stated he intends to review certain aspects of the tax reform approved during Lula's government, particularly the 28% rate, which he deems excessive. He justified the lack of an alternative proposal and acknowledged advances in tax simplification. The statement follows endorsement from 17 state directories of MDB for his candidacy.

item.title: Flávio reitera que votará pelo fim da 6x1 e diz que maioria do PL deve seguir a opinião dele
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro reiterated his support for the PEC that eliminates the 6x1 work schedule, stating that the majority of the PL should follow his position. He has not yet spoken with the party but believes the bench will follow his stance.

item.title: Casado: MDB é mais uma peça no tabuleiro de apoios do centrão a Flávio
item.description: MDB's support for Flávio Bolsonaro in the runoff reflects the centrão alliance strategy, according to Letícia Casado. The columnist noted that the pursuit of political influence attracts fragmented endorsements, illustrating the strategic behavior of regional parties.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro: 'Não vou no debate da Band domingo'
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) stated he will not participate in the Band debate on Sunday, 18. He mentioned that attendance at the final second-round debate against Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) is still being evaluated by the campaign.

item.title: Mesmo com Marçal na campanha, PRTB nega apoio e acusa Flávio de 'enganar conservadores'
item.description: The PRTB denies support for Flávio Marçal and accuses him of deceiving conservative sectors, even with his involvement in the campaign. Leonardo Avalanche confirms the party will not support any presidential candidate.

item.title: Última pesquisa presidente segundo turno: veja números atualizados de Lula e Flávio
item.description: Polls measure the 2026 second round between Lula (PT) and Flávio Bolsonaro (PL), with margins of error of 2 points and 1.8 percentage points, respectively. The data reflect the electoral race but do not indicate specific preferences.

item.title: Nunes defende redução da maioridade penal em ato do MDB com Flávio
item.description: São Paulo Mayor Ricardo Nunes (MDB) reaffirmed the party's support for Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) in the runoff, advocating for lowering the age of criminal responsibility during an event in São Paulo. Nunes emphasized public security and criticized the competition for not prioritizing the fight against crime.

item.title: Lula promete criação do Pé-de-Meia para universitários em 2027
item.description: Lula announced the creation of the 'Pé-de-Meia' for university students in a potential fourth term starting in 2027, with an estimated cost of R$ 4.6 billion funded by the oil social fund. The initiative is expected to benefit around one million young people annually, expanding support for public higher education.

item.title: Ao vivo: TSE analisa ação sobre gastos com publicidade de Lula
item.description: The TSE opened an extraordinary virtual session to judge cases involving PT and PL, including a accusation by PL against Lula and the Secom minister for excessive institutional advertising expenses. Minister André Mendonça ordered the submission of detailed expense information between 2023 and 2026, highlighting discrepancies in the data.

item.title: Nunes Marques alerta campanhas para alta de 200% na judicialização eleitoral
item.description: TSE president Kassio Nunes Marques warned campaigns about a 217% increase in election-related lawsuits after the first round of 2026, highlighting risks to democracy and political debate. A meeting with representatives from Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro discussed disinformation, deepfakes, and server protection. The TSE provided image and voice protection tools to candidates.

item.title: Ibovespa desvaloriza mais de 1% com realização de lucros e incerteza eleitoral
item.description: The Ibovespa fell 1.04% to 206,800 points, driven by profit-taking and election uncertainty tied to Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ). External tensions (US-Iran) and the Boletim Focus forecasts, which lower Selic expectations and raise inflation for 2026, also influenced the market.

item.title: Papo Antagonista: O escândalo das Refugiadas de Vorcaro e o impasse dos MEIs com Lula
item.description: The Antagonist Chat discusses Lula's announced debt forgiveness for microentrepreneurs and the scandal involving Daniel Vorcaro in funding a network of female modeling for private events. The former Banco Master controller is under investigation for allegedly organizing a prostitution network with involvement of public figures.

item.title: Lula leva segurança e 6x1 à TV na véspera de votações no Senado
item.description: Lula releases campaign ad supporting public security and ending the 6x1 work schedule ahead of Senate votes, pressuring opponents for support and promoting anti-organized crime proposals.

item.title: Erika Hilton promete acionar TSE contra “Tropa do Flávio”
item.description: Erika Hilton (PSOL-SP) promised to file a lawsuit with the TSE to block the 'Tropa do Flávio' WhatsApp channel, citing similar irregularities to those of the 'Exército do Lula'. The TSE president's decision was later reconsidered.
